name: team
description: Project teammates (ADR 0031): a named, persistent agent per role per project, a notes file that is its memory of record, and a serial inbox any session in the project summons it through.

tools.name: team.add
tools.summary: add a teammate to a project

tools.name: team.role.fill
tools.summary: have one of your agents fill a role

tools.name: team.act.target
tools.summary: the destination an asked team call must be said for

tools.name: team.roster
tools.summary: a project's live roles and duties, for recording what the person asked for

tools.name: team.duties.start
tools.summary: turn a proposed duty on when the person asked for exactly it

settings.label: Default new work to teammates
settings.help: Ongoing work (design, review, research, QA) steers to a project teammate over a subagent, and @role creates one on first use. Off leaves existing teammates working, just stops steering new work at them.

tips.text: Send work to a teammate from the terminal: `vyre team ask design "Make the estate intake calmer"`.
tips.command: vyre team ask design "Make the estate intake calmer"

tips.text: See this project's teammates, their state and queue with `vyre team`.
Give the project a teammate: `vyre team add design --brief "visual design and UI copy"`.
tips.command: vyre team add design --brief "visual design and UI copy"

tips.text: A request that cannot wait: `vyre team ask design "..." --urgent`. It jumps its teammate's own queue, never the server-wide slot queue.
Stop steering new work at teammates in this project with `team.default.set`. Existing teammates still work.
